events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to NoHax, fawkyouto0, cukimaiii, R5N3T, and ablationvector.

events.title: ChatGPT getting dumber?
events.description: Rick4pex broke down how ChatGPT used to feel sharper for coding, cybersecurity questions, and product comparisons, contrasting it with recent refusals and weaker outputs — sparking discussion of safety filters, model changes, and Perplexity as an alternative.

events.title: How old were you when you began using a computer?
events.description: Tyr asked members to share their first memories with computers, sparking a nostalgic discussion that highlighted just how diverse the HF user base is.

events.title: Office24 ProPlus2024 serial
events.description: Jamika shared an Office key with the community — a small gesture that exemplifies what HF community sharing is about.

events.title: [Legends] Brute force AI tool that tries really hard to behave like a human user
events.description: JoseMar surfaced BruteForceAI, a tool that blends brute forcing with LLM-driven behavior to mimic real users — DOM analysis, adaptive retries, human-like delays and jitter — raising awareness for red-team, blue-team, and defensive security work.

events.title: [EDUCATIONAL] Predicting RNG Output via Reverse Engineering
events.description: Rick4pex shared an educational walkthrough on why weak pseudorandom generators are dangerous, including reversing common PRNGs, reconstructing internal state from outputs, and real-world demos tied to games and applications.

events.title: GFX Image of the Week
events.description: Motusora's animated GFX piece was featured as the HF News image of the week.
